text_source.rendering: Keep complete sanitized description in DOM with paragraphs. If taller than the adjacent photo, collapse visually and show Читать далее; expand without losing text.

image_source.when_missing: Omit figure; use project-description--text-only for a readable single text column. Do not substitute unrelated photo.

preview.description: Short illustration composed from facts already present in this preview and the previous audited Vavilova card; the original full CRM description was not retained in the audit. Replace with the full public field when the adapter is connected.

disclosure.threshold: Full text taller than rendered adjacent image. Reserve the measured link-button height plus 16px gap inside that height.
disclosure.mobile_or_no_photo: Preview budget of 8 text lines including disclosure control; short descriptions remain fully visible.
disclosure.accessibility: Native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, keyboard operation; clipped interactive descendants removed from tab order and restored on expand. Full source text remains in DOM.
disclosure.no_javascript: Show complete text, hide the disclosure button.
